title: 통신사 고객센터: 요금이 왜 많이 나왔는지 묻기
objective: Ask why your bill went up, using -는지.
summary: A call to a carrier about a high bill.
setting: A phone call to a mobile carrier's customer center. Maria's phone bill this month is much higher than usual, and she calls to find out why.

task.title: Ask about your bill
task.line: Use the words and the -는지 pattern from page 1 to complete, choose, or answer each item.

words.exampleMeaning: I was charged for a service I never even used.

words.example: 해외에서 전화를 받으면 추가 요금이 나올 수 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: You may get an extra charge if you take calls abroad.

words.meaning: add-on service (extra paid feature on a phone plan)
words.example: 필요 없는 부가 서비스는 정리하는 게 좋아요.
words.exampleMeaning: It's a good idea to get rid of add-on services you don't need.

words.example: 다음 달부터 안 쓸 거니까 해지해 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: I won't use it from next month, so please cancel it.

words.meaning: to activate (a new phone or line)
words.example: 새 휴대폰은 매장에서 바로 개통할 수 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: You can activate a new phone right away at the store.

dialogue.korean: 안녕하세요, 고객센터 상담원 김지은입니다. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
dialogue.meaning: Hello, this is Kim Ji-eun at the customer center. How can I help you?

dialogue.korean: 이번 달 요금이 평소보다 많이 나와서요. 왜 이렇게 많이 나왔는지 알고 싶어요.
dialogue.meaning: My bill this month is much higher than usual. I'd like to know why it's so high.

dialogue.korean: 네, 고객님. 확인해 보니 지난달에 데이터를 기본 제공량보다 많이 쓰셔서 이번 달 요금에 추가 요금이 나왔습니다. 그리고 부가 서비스 요금도 청구됐습니다.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, ma'am. I've checked, and you used more data than your basic allowance last month, so there is an extra charge on this month's bill. You were also charged for an add-on service.

dialogue.korean: 부가 서비스요? 제가 그런 걸 신청했는지 기억이 안 나는데요.
dialogue.meaning: An add-on service? I don't remember signing up for anything like that.

dialogue.korean: 휴대폰을 개통하실 때 한 달 무료로 가입하셨는데, 이번 달부터 유료로 바뀌었습니다. 해지해 드릴까요?
dialogue.meaning: You got it free for one month when you activated your phone, but it became a paid service this month. Shall I cancel it for you?

dialogue.korean: 네, 오늘 바로 해지해 주세요. 그리고 데이터를 더 많이 쓸 수 있는 요금제도 문자로 보내 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, please cancel it today. And please text me some plans that give me more data.

exercises: Complete each sentence with the right -는지 form of the word in brackets (note: 이다 becomes 인지): ① 이 요금제가 한 달에 얼마(이다) ____ 알려 주세요. ② 지난달에 문자를 몇 개 (보내다) ____ 확인하고 싶어요.
Choose the right word: ① 이제 그 앱을 안 쓰니까 서비스를 (개통하고 / 해지하고) 싶어요. ② 통신사에 가입한 날 매장에서 바로 휴대폰을 (개통했어요 / 청구됐어요).
Answer in English based on the dialogue: Why was Maria's bill higher this month? Give two reasons.
Answer in one Korean sentence using -는지: Your bill shows a charge for an international call (국제 전화), but you never made one. Tell the agent you want to know why it was billed.
answers: She used more data than her plan's data allowance, so there was an extra charge. Also, an add-on service she got free for one month when she activated her phone became a paid service this month.
Example answer: 국제 전화 요금이 왜 청구됐는지 알고 싶어요. (Other correct sentences that use 왜 ...는지, such as 국제 전화를 한 적이 없는데 왜 청구됐는지 알고 싶어요, are also correct.)
